messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I decided to take a leisurely stroll in search of inspiration, and as fate would have it - I ended up here!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我决定悠闲散步寻找灵感,而命运使然——我来到了这里!

messages.text: These...these speak to me. There's something about them. You have inspired me once again!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 这些……这些在对我说话。它们有种特别的东西。你又一次给了我灵感!

messages.text: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere. You, my friend, need to open your eyes.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 如果你真正热爱自然,就会在处处发现美。我的朋友,你得睁开眼睛。
